title: Can Rabbits Eat Nectarines?
description: It does not replace advice from a rabbit-savvy vet. If your rabbit stops eating, stops pooing, seems in pain or is suddenly unwell, contact a vet…
body:
<div class="wp-block-group alignfull">
<!--
RabbitCare.co.uk blog article block
Page: Can Rabbits Eat Nectarines?
How to use in WordPress:
1) Edit the blog page/post.
2) Add a "Custom HTML" block.
3) Replace the old article content with everything below.

Notes:
- No custom header/nav or footer included.
- Internal links use root-relative URLs.
- Uses the same visual style as the RabbitCare homepage and rabbit food guides.
-->

<section class="rcn-page alignfull" id="can-rabbits-eat-nectarine">
  <style>
    :root {
      --rc-cream: #fff9ef;
      --rc-cream-2: #f6ead8;
      --rc-sage: #7f9b72;
      --rc-sage-dark: #4e6b45;
      --rc-moss: #2f4a2e;
      --rc-brown: #8a6246;
      --rc-gold: #d7a64b;
      --rc-charcoal: #2d2d2b;
      --rc-muted: #6f6a61;
      --rc-white: #ffffff;
      --rc-danger: #9b3b2f;
      --rc-danger-soft: #fff0eb;
      --rc-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.16);
      --rc-radius-xl: 34px;
      --rc-radius-lg: 24px;
      --rc-radius-md: 16px;
      --rc-max: 1180px;
      --rc-font-heading: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      --rc-font-body: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    }

    .rcn-page,
    .rcn-page * { box-sizing: border-box; }

    body,
    .wp-site-blocks,
    .entry-content,
    .wp-block-post-content,
    main { background: #fef4f0 !important; }

    body .wp-site-blocks,
    body .entry-content,
    body .wp-block-post-content,
    body main,
    body article,
    body .wp-block-group,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      gap: 0 !important;
      row-gap: 0 !important;
    }

    body .entry-header,
    body .page-header,
    body .wp-block-post-title,
    body h1.wp-block-post-title,
    body .wp-block-post-featured-image { display: none !important; }

    body .wp-site-blocks > * + *,
    body .entry-content > * + *,
    body .wp-block-post-content > * + * { margin-block-start: 0 !important; }

    body .wp-block-html,
    body .entry-content > .wp-block-html,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      margin-bottom: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      padding-bottom: 0 !important;
    }

    .rcn-page {
      position: relative;
      left: calc(50% + 20px);
      width: calc(100vw + 40px);
      max-width: none;
      margin: -120px 0 0 !important;
      padding: 0 !important;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      font-family: var(--rc-font-body);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.18), transparent 32rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, var(--rc-cream) 0%, #fffdf8 46%, #fef4f0 100%);
      overflow-x: hidden;
      line-height: 1.68;
    }

    .rcn-page a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }

    .rcn-page a:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.9);
      outline-offset: 4px;
      border-radius: 10px;
    }

    .rcn-wrap { width: min(var(--rc-max), calc(100% - 34px)); margin: 0 auto; }
    .rcn-narrow { width: min(920px, calc(100% - 34px)); margin: 0 auto; }

    .rcn-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .rcn-pill::before { content: "✦"; color: var(--rc-gold); }

    .rcn-btns {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 14px;
      align-items: center;
      margin-top: 30px;
    }

    .rcn-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 52px;
      padding: 14px 22px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-weight: 900;
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, background 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcn-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); }

    .rcn-btn-primary {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--rc-sage-dark), var(--rc-sage));
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(79, 112, 70, 0.26);
    }

    .rcn-btn-secondary {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.16);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rcn-hero {
      padding: 0 0 42px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 20%, rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.18), transparent 28rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #fff9ef 0%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0) 100%);
    }

    .rcn-hero-image-wrap {
      width: 100%;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      background: #fff9ef;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rcn-hero-cover { position: relative; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; }

    .rcn-hero-cover::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.68), rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.24) 45%, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.04)),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18), transparent 45%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.12));
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rcn-hero-image {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      object-fit: contain;
      object-position: center;
      background: #fff;
      animation: rcnFadeIn 0.9s ease both;
    }

    .rcn-hero-title-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 2;
      left: max(24px, calc((100vw - var(--rc-max)) / 2));
      bottom: clamp(28px, 8vw, 96px);
      max-width: 720px;
      padding: clamp(20px, 4vw, 38px);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .rcn-hero-title-overlay .rcn-pill {
      color: #ffffff;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    }

    .rcn-hero-title-overlay h1 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 7rem);
      line-height: 0.88;
      letter-spacing: -0.065em;
      color: #ffffff;
      text-wrap: balance;
      text-shadow: 0 5px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42);
    }

    .rcn-hero-title-overlay p {
      max-width: 560px;
      margin: 0;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
      font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2vw, 1.35rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.36);
    }

    .rcn-hero-content {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 0.95fr;
      gap: 34px;
      align-items: center;
      padding-top: 44px;
    }

    .rcn-breadcrumb {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .rcn-breadcrumb a { color: var(--rc-sage-dark); }

    .rcn-intro-heading {
      margin: 12px 0 16px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.4rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rcn-hero-subtitle {
      max-width: 720px;
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: clamp(1.08rem, 2vw, 1.28rem);
    }

    .rcn-hero-card {
      padding: 28px;
      border-radius: 38px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .rcn-hero-card h2 {
      margin: 0 0 14px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.35rem;
      line-height: 1.18;
    }

    .rcn-hero-card ul {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcn-hero-card li {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 32px 1fr;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: start;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .rcn-hero-card li::before {
      content: "✓";
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rcn-quickbar { position: relative; z-index: 4; margin-top: 26px; }

    .rcn-quickbar-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 14px;
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .rcn-quick {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 62px 1fr;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      min-height: 96px;
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff, #fff8eb);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcn-quick:hover {
      transform: translateY(-5px);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(83, 61, 42, 0.14);
    }

    .rcn-quick-icon {
      width: 62px;
      height: 62px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      font-size: 2.35rem;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .rcn-quick strong {
      display: block;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      line-height: 1.15;
      font-size: 1.02rem;
    }

    .rcn-quick span span {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 4px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .rcn-section { width: 100%; padding: 72px 0; position: relative; }

    .rcn-section-header {
      max-width: 780px;
      margin: 0 auto 32px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .rcn-section h2,
    .rcn-final h2 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.6rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rcn-section-header p {
      margin: 0 auto;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.08rem;
      max-width: 680px;
    }

    .rcn-article-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 320px;
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: start;
    }

    .rcn-content { display: grid; gap: 24px; }

    .rcn-panel {
      position: relative;
      padding: clamp(24px, 4vw, 38px);
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 48px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rcn-panel::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 190px;
      height: 190px;
      right: -82px;
      top: -92px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.10);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rcn-panel > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
    .rcn-panel h2 { margin-top: 0; }

    .rcn-panel h3 {
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.45rem;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .rcn-panel p {
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.03rem;
    }

    .rcn-panel p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

    .rcn-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 22px 0 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcn-list li {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 38px 1fr;
      gap: 12px;
      align-items: start;
      padding: 15px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.9);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.10);
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .rcn-list li::before {
      content: "✓";
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 38px;
      height: 38px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rcn-treat-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rcn-treat-card {
      padding: 24px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcn-treat-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      box-shadow: 0 24px 58px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15);
    }

    .rcn-treat-card b {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 54px;
      height: 54px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 1.2rem;
    }

    .rcn-treat-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.22rem; }
    .rcn-treat-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rcn-warning {
      padding: 68px 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 240, 235, 0.56), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rcn-warning-card {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr;
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: center;
      padding: clamp(24px, 5vw, 44px);
      border-radius: 42px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 2px solid rgba(155, 59, 47, 0.16);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
    }

    .rcn-warning-card h2 { color: var(--rc-danger); }

    .rcn-warning-card p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.06rem;
    }

    .rcn-warning-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcn-warning-list li {
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: var(--rc-danger-soft);
      color: #4a2823;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .rcn-warning-list strong {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
      color: var(--rc-danger);
      font-size: 1.05rem;
    }

    .rcn-image-split {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.95fr 1.05fr;
      gap: 30px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .rcn-image-card { position: relative; min-height: 430px; }

    .rcn-image-card img {
      position: absolute;
      object-fit: cover;
      display: block;
      border: 10px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      transition: transform 0.35s ease;
    }

    .rcn-image-card img:hover { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1.03) !important; }

    .rcn-img-main {
      width: 78%;
      height: 340px;
      left: 0;
      top: 20px;
      border-radius: 42px;
      transform: rotate(-2deg);
    }

    .rcn-img-small {
      width: 52%;
      height: 230px;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      border-radius: 34px;
      transform: rotate(4deg);
      object-fit: contain !important;
      background: #fff9ef;
    }

    .rcn-prep {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0), rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.09), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rcn-steps {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rcn-step {
      padding: 24px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rcn-step b {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.15);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 1.15rem;
    }

    .rcn-step h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.16rem; }
    .rcn-step p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rcn-sidebar {
      position: sticky;
      top: 22px;
      display: grid;
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .rcn-side-card {
      padding: 22px;
      border-radius: 28px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rcn-side-card h2 {
      margin: 0 0 14px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.18rem;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .rcn-side-card ul {
      display: grid;
      gap: 10px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcn-side-card a {
      display: block;
      padding: 11px 12px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: #fff9ef;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 850;
      transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
    }

    .rcn-side-card a:hover { transform: translateX(4px); background: #fff4d8; }

    .rcn-note {
      padding: 20px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border-left: 6px solid var(--rc-gold);
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.08);
    }

    .rcn-note strong { color: var(--rc-moss); }

    .rcn-benefits-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 24px;
    }

    .rcn-benefit {
      padding: 22px;
      border-radius: 26px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 14px 36px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.08);
    }

    .rcn-benefit h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.15rem; }
    .rcn-benefit p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rcn-final { padding: 70px 0 42px; background: #fef4f0; }

    .rcn-final-box {
      padding: clamp(28px, 5vw, 52px);
      border-radius: 46px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(28, 48, 27, 0.92), rgba(58, 84, 49, 0.86)),
        url("/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Rabbitcare-nectarine.png");
      background-size: cover;
      background-position: center;
      color: #ffffff;
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rcn-final-box .rcn-pill,
    .rcn-final-box h2,
    .rcn-final-box p {
      color: #ffffff;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    }

    .rcn-final-box p {
      max-width: 780px;
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      font-size: 1.08rem;
    }

    .rcn-final-box .rcn-btn-secondary {
      background: #ffffff;
      color: #2f4a2e;
      border: 2px solid #ffffff;
      box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
      text-shadow: none;
    }

    .rcn-related {
      padding: 74px 0;
      background: #fff9ef;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      transform: none !important;
      animation: none !important;
    }

    .rcn-related,
    .rcn-related * {
      opacity: 1 !important;
      filter: none !important;
      text-shadow: none !important;
    }

    .rcn-related .rcn-section-header {
      padding: 30px;
      border-radius: 34px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 2px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.22);
      box-shadow: 0 20px 54px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.14);
    }

    .rcn-related .rcn-section-header .rcn-pill { color: #4e6b45 !important; }

    .rcn-related .rcn-section-header h2 {
      color: #243320 !important;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      text-shadow: none !important;
    }

    .rcn-related .rcn-section-header p {
      color: #332d26 !important;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      text-shadow: none !important;
      font-weight: 650;
    }

    .rcn-related-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rcn-related-card {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 92px 1fr;
      gap: 15px;
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: #ffffff !important;
      border: 2px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.22);
      box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15);
      transition: transform 0.22s ease, background 0.22s ease;
    }

    .rcn-related-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); background: #fff; }

    .rcn-related-card img {
      width: 92px;
      height: 92px;
      max-width: 92px;

            <span class="rcn-pill">Rabbit food guide</span>
            <h2>Nectarine is a juicy stone fruit rabbits can enjoy in moderation</h2>
            <p>
              Nectarines are smooth-skinned stone fruits closely related to peaches, and their sweet, juicy flesh is something many rabbits find appealing. The flesh is safe for rabbits to eat and does not need to be peeled, the skin is fine to leave on.
            </p>
            <p>
              However, nectarine is a larger, juicier and more sugary fruit than berries, which means portions need to be kept particularly small. More importantly, the stone at the centre of every nectarine must always be removed entirely before feeding. The stone itself is a physical hazard, and the kernel inside it contains compounds that can be harmful.
            </p>

            <span class="rcn-pill">Safe with the right preparation</span>
            <h2>Is nectarine safe for rabbits?</h2>
            <p>
              Yes, the flesh and skin of a ripe nectarine are safe for most healthy adult rabbits when offered in small amounts. Nectarine should be treated as a sweet occasional treat rather than a vegetable or everyday food, its higher sugar and moisture content make it less suitable for regular feeding than leafy greens.
            </p>
            <p>
              The most important rule with nectarine is simple: always remove the stone. Never offer a whole nectarine or a half with the stone still present. Once the stone is out and the flesh is cut into small pieces, nectarine can be a pleasant and well-received treat.
            </p>

          <p>

          <p>

          <span class="rcn-pill">Important safety warning</span>
          <h2>Always remove the stone, it is not safe for rabbits</h2>
          <p>
            The stone at the centre of a nectarine must be removed before feeding. It presents two separate risks: a physical choking and obstruction hazard, and a chemical one, as the kernel inside the stone contains amygdalin, a compound that can release cyanide when broken down.
          </p>
        </div>

        <ul class="rcn-warning-list">
          <li>
            <strong>Remove the stone every time</strong>
            Never offer a whole nectarine or a halved nectarine with the stone in place. Always cut the flesh away from the stone and discard it safely before feeding.
          </li>

          <li>
            <strong>Check for stone fragments</strong>
            When cutting around the stone, check the flesh for any small fragments that may have broken off, and remove them before serving.
          </li>

          <li>
            <strong>No tinned, dried or sweetened nectarine</strong>
            Only use fresh, ripe nectarine. Tinned nectarine in syrup, dried nectarine and any processed nectarine products contain far too much sugar and are not suitable for rabbits.
          </li>
        </ul>
      </div>

            <p>Use a fresh, fully ripe nectarine. Avoid overripe, mouldy or very unripe fruit, and never use tinned or dried nectarine.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcn-step">
            <b>2</b>
            <h3>Wash thoroughly</h3>
            <p>Rinse the nectarine under cold water to remove any dirt, wax or pesticide residue from the smooth skin.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcn-step">
            <b>3</b>
            <h3>Remove the stone</h3>
            <p>Cut the flesh away from the stone and discard the stone completely. Check for any small fragments before serving.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcn-step">
            <b>4</b>
            <h3>Cut into small pieces</h3>
            <p>Slice the flesh into small cubes. The skin can stay on. Offer one or two small pieces and store any remainder in the fridge.</p>
          </article>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="rcn-section rcn-reveal" id="benefits">
      <div class="rcn-wrap">
        <div class="rcn-section-header">
          <span class="rcn-pill">Treat benefits</span>
          <h2>Benefits and signs your rabbit enjoys nectarine</h2>
          <p>
            When prepared correctly and offered in moderation, nectarine can be a very well-received treat. Most rabbits respond to it enthusiastically, which is also a reminder to keep portions firmly controlled.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div class="rcn-benefits-grid">
          <article class="rcn-benefit">
            <h3>Highly palatable</h3>
            <p>The sweet fragrant flesh of nectarine appeals to most rabbits immediately, making it one of the more reliable fruit treats.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcn-benefit">
            <h3>Small amounts of vitamins</h3>
            <p>Nectarine provides vitamins A and C in small amounts, complementing a diet already rich in hay and leafy greens.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcn-benefit">
            <h3>No peeling needed</h3>
            <p>Unlike some fruits, nectarine skin is perfectly safe and there is no need to peel it before feeding, one less preparation step.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcn-benefit">
            <h3>Bonding treat</h3>
            <p>Because most rabbits love nectarine, it can work well as a reward during gentle handling or as a positive bonding moment.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcn-benefit">
            <h3>Signs they enjoy it</h3>
            <p>Your rabbit may run over eagerly, sniff intensely, chew with clear enthusiasm or nudge your hand looking for more.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcn-benefit">
            <h3>Keep portions small</h3>
            <p>Enthusiasm from your rabbit is not a reason to offer more. Keep to one or two small cubes regardless of how keenly they respond.</p>
          </article>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>


    <section class="rcn-faq rcn-reveal" id="faqs" aria-label="Rabbit nectarine FAQs">
      <div class="rcn-narrow">
        <div class="rcn-section-header">
          <span class="rcn-pill">Frequently asked questions</span>
          <h2>Nectarine FAQs</h2>
          <p>Quick answers to common questions about feeding nectarines to rabbits.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="rcn-faq-list">
          <details class="rcn-faq-item">
            <summary>Can rabbits eat nectarines?</summary>
            <p>Yes, rabbits can eat fresh nectarine flesh in small amounts. Nectarine is sweet and juicy, so it should be treated as an occasional fruit treat rather than a daily food.</p>
          </details>

          <details class="rcn-faq-item">
            <summary>Can rabbits eat nectarine skin?</summary>
            <p>Yes, rabbits can eat nectarine skin if the fruit is washed well. The smooth skin is fine to leave on, but the stone must always be removed before feeding.</p>
          </details>

          <details class="rcn-faq-item">
            <summary>Can rabbits eat nectarine stones?</summary>
            <p>No. Rabbits should never eat nectarine stones. They are a choking and obstruction risk, and the kernel inside contains compounds that can be harmful.</p>
          </details>

          <details class="rcn-faq-item">
            <summary>How much nectarine can rabbits eat?</summary>
            <p>One or two small cubes of nectarine flesh is enough for most healthy adult rabbits. Offer nectarine no more than once or twice a week and start with a tiny piece the first time.</p>
          </details>

          <details class="rcn-faq-item">
            <summary>Can baby rabbits eat nectarines?</summary>
            <p>Baby rabbits should not be given sugary fruit treats like nectarine. Young rabbits need a stable diet based around hay, water and age-appropriate rabbit food.</p>
          </details>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="rcn-final rcn-reveal">
      <div class="rcn-wrap rcn-final-box">
        <span class="rcn-pill">Final thoughts</span>
        <h2>Nectarine can be a safe and popular rabbit treat when prepared correctly</h2>
        <p>
          Rabbits can eat fresh nectarine flesh in small amounts, and most take to it very readily. The flesh and skin are both safe, the stone is the only part that must never be offered, and it should always be removed and discarded before feeding.
        </p>
        <p>
          Keep portions to one or two small cubes at a time, offer nectarine no more than once or twice a week, and never use tinned, dried or sweetened versions. As with all fruit, nectarine is a treat on top of a diet that should be based firmly on hay, with fresh vegetables and leafy greens making up the rest of your rabbit's daily food.
        </p>
